url.window: ?window=24h|7d|30d, default 24h until snapshots exist, then 7d; omitted when default
url.market: ?market=<venue>:<market_id> loads that market in the Price Chart; survives refresh and share
url.history: filters use router.replace (no history entry per chip click); loading a market into the chart uses replace as well

filter_bar.position: sticky, top = shared chrome height (76px), z above cards, below the chrome

category.count: live count of open markets for that category under the current venue filter, mono
category.mobile: horizontal scroll, no wrap, scroll-snap optional

window.disabled_tooltip: Longer windows arrive with price history

search.style: transparent pill, matches the Sonar search pill

filter_bar.mobile: venue, window and search move into a bottom sheet opened by a 'Filters' chip that shows the count of non-default filters; sheet has Reset and 'Show N markets'

filters_apply_to.chart: unaffected; it shows whichever market is loaded
filters_apply_to.top_traders: Polymarket category follows the page category when it maps to a leaderboard category; Kalshi ignores category

load_market_into_chart.effect: sets ?market=, chart refetches history, the Movers row (if present) takes the selected treatment
load_market_into_chart.mobile: also scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' }) on the chart card, respecting reduced motion
load_market_into_chart.default_market: the first Movers row on first load

tiles: Volume traded (window), Polymarket USD and Kalshi contracts side by side
Biggest mover: change pill, 8-point sparkline, question
Closing this week: count + 7 day bars, today emerald

chart.switcher: dropdown of the current Movers list plus previous/next arrows; label 'n / 8 Movers'
chart.hover: vertical crosshair, horizontal guide, dot on line, tooltip (date and time ET, probability, change vs prior point, period volume), y-axis value flag; keyboard: arrow keys move the crosshair point by point when the plot is focused
chart.annotations: the two largest absolute single-period moves in range, diamond marker + '+3.0 pts' label
chart.multi_outcome: up to 4 outcomes, end-of-line labels 'Name 78.7%', legend in the header; colours blue, orange, purple, then muted dashed for Other
chart.outbound: 'Open on Polymarket' / 'Open on Kalshi', target _blank rel noopener, visually hidden '(opens in a new tab)'

movers.row_click: loads the chart; aria-current=true on the loaded row

edge_board.tab_count: mono count of rows after filters
edge_board.expand: chevron button per row, aria-expanded; one row open at a time; shows the math (5 lines) and liquidity
edge_board.signed_out: the expanded panel renders blurred with the 'Sign up free to open the math' overlay; the board itself is fully visible

polymarket_controls.category: chip showing the page category, 'from page filter'

kalshi_controls.window: fixed 30d, shown as a disabled chip

top_traders.expand: Polymarket rows only; top 3 open positions by size (market, side, size, avg price); one open at a time
top_traders.copy_wallet: copies the full address, announces 'Address copied' via a polite live region

category_map.tile_click: sets ?category= and the filter bar chip; selected tile gets a 2px emerald border; aria-pressed
category_map.mobile: stacked horizontal bar + list rows with the same encoding

closing_soon.more: '+N more' link opens the open markets table filtered to that day
closing_soon.callout: three open markets resolving within 7 days whose probability is closest to 50%

conviction.hover: tooltip with question, probability, liquidity (or volume for Kalshi), spread
conviction.keyboard: the plot is one focusable group; a visually hidden table lists the top 20 markets by liquidity with the same fields

states.loading: shimmer skeleton in the card's own shape, reserve the final height; no spinners
states.empty: one sentence naming the active filters and a way out (Reset filters / a wider window)
states.error: This data is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment. + Retry button that refetches only that card
states.stale: if the trending feed reports stale=true, Pulse and Movers show 'Odds delayed' next to the timestamp rather than old numbers

keyboard.focus_ring: 2px --emerald outline, 2px offset, on every chip, segment, tab, row button, tile, pill and chart control
keyboard.tabs: role=tablist, arrow keys move between tabs
keyboard.rows: each clickable row is a <button>; expanders are separate buttons with aria-expanded
keyboard.escape: closes the mobile filter sheet and returns focus to the Filters chip
